comment: This is a current source-first semantic review of all 53 curated source items against the 50-row PaperInterface and three explicit model-assumption rows. Every coverage link is pinned to the exact source item, digest, and location; direct theorem endpoints are distinguished from source-model conventions, scoped construction components, proof support, and defect refutations. The three visible boundaries are the user-approved event-calibration, mixture-conditioning, and finite-partition/null-cell readings recorded as formalized notes. All six quarantined printed defects remain support-only and require the separate exact-hash defect audit.

source_formula_opening_zero_one_loss.reason: The support theorem states for every binary prediction and label-one probability that expected correctness equals one minus 0-1 loss. That is the precise correction of the opening display's mistaken accuracy label, so the printed formula is quarantined rather than counted as a proved source claim.
